title: Extreme Value Theory in Lean
description: A Lean 4 library, built on Mathlib, of machine-checked extreme value theory and heavy-tailed probability: limits of maxima and the Fisher-Tippett-Gnedenko theorem, regular variation, peaks over threshold, estimators, likelihood and return levels, stable laws, extremes of dependent sequences, multivariate extremes, point processes and the Skorokhod space. The Fisher-Tippett-Gnedenko development and its blueprint are based on ExtremeValueProject by Kalle Kytölä and the participants of the Aalto University course MS-EV0029. The statements, audits and tests were written with AI assistance and have not yet been reviewed by human experts.
